method: Every live fact read as one line (reg-compact.txt); duplicates found by overlapping quote spans and claim-token similarity (reg_analyze.py, reg-analysis.txt, reg-pairs-DUP.txt). Decisions in reg-decisions.json (supersede map and reject); display, claim, evidence, tier and relevance changes in reg-spec.json, built into reg-patches/ by reg_build.py (checks every number-free display: verbatim from a quote, at most 8 words) and applied one by one with saa.py facts amend. Demand statuses merged into brief.v0.json by reg_demand.py.
rules_applied: Duplicates: superseded when two facts quote the same sentence (or the same table row) of one page, or state the same rule on two guide pages; kept the fact with the most direct quote and the better displays. The decisions miner's dec-* copies of behavior facts were the main source (79 superseded).
FAQ facts that repeat a guide value stay for the FAQ quick-fire (for example faq-default-expiration-24h next to default-edge-expiration-24h); two FAQ facts that quote one FAQ answer were merged.

Displays without a number: a verbatim phrase of at most 8 words from one quote (RULINGS 2026-10-11); about 120 displays shortened, replaced or dropped. Exception: cloudfront-price-class-100 and -200 take their display from the table header of the price class table.

Claims cut to their evidence: ddos-cache-hierarchy-protects-origin (request collapsing only), origin-request-default-not-forwarded, removed-origin-file-stays-until-expiry, real-time-logs-kinesis-data-streams, faq-regional-edge-cache-larger-cache-width. Evidence added: faq-functions-complement-lambda-edge ('not replace it'), functions-use-cases (two list items), realtime-logs-best-effort-delivery (late or never delivered).
Source tier: 13 FAQ-sourced facts set from tier 1 to tier 2.

Relevance: edge-compare-languages, faq-anycast-static-ips-what, faq-origin-mtls-origin-verifies-cloudfront and faq-viewer-mtls-trust-store-bidirectional raised to core after absorbing core duplicates; FAQ figures that the guide does not teach set to reference with a note (faq-invalidation-individual-objects-in-progress, faq-invalidation-wildcard-paths-in-progress, faq-max-single-file-30-gb).
Namespace: all facts sit in cloudfront or global-accelerator; whitepaper and decision-guide facts about these services stay in their namespaces.
